title: Fenton Catalyst Schema Filler
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 7 (split version): one instance per paper fills the metadata block plus the 45 fields of every catalyst node (characterization data, no curves or variables). Every field is produced directly as a {value, unit, raw} triple (value numeric, unit canonical, raw faithful to the source), with a complete worked few-shot example. Value priority: errata, then the 5% figure-text rule, then the text, then empty. Read-only; the main agent assembles 06_schema.json.
